Definition: masculine from G2290; a grave (the place of interment):--sepulchre, tomb.
BiblicalUsage: The word is the tomb, the grave where the dead are laid. Mary Magdalene and the other Mary sat over against the sepulchre where Jesus was buried, and came again at the dawn of the first day. Paul quotes the psalm that says their throat is an open sepulchre, full of the stench of death.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the tomb could not hold the Lord whose body lay in it, and the open grave of man's throat is shut only by grace.
